name: DOORWORLD_ST_INIT
meaning: Update 0: asks the DoorLevel (msg 0x5900); closed -> 6, else hidden and never updated -> 1 (inferred)

name: DOORWORLD_ST_IDLE
meaning: set from 0 and 6; no Update case (inferred)

name: DOORWORLD_ST_OPENED
meaning: Update 5: after 1000 ms notifies the requester (msg 0x4e00) and stops updating (inferred)

name: DOORWORLD_ST_CLOSE
meaning: Update 6: normal update mode, anim CLOSE1, visible, -> 1 (inferred)
